A few things you can do with me right now:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Chat and calls** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me if you want any of these.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with the passwords and one-time codes kept in my password store; I'll ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- Also: scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, and talking by voice.
